verdict.rationale: Smooth documents a public REST API covering running tasks, interactive sessions, and custom tools. The reference includes concrete endpoints for listing tasks, cancelling tasks, and sending session events (run_task, goto, extract, evaluate_js, close), plus documented polling semantics and a 4-line SDK quickstart. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API itself.
